note: Hand-built from the response shape documented at docs.typesafe.ai/api-reference (snapshot 2026-09-25). No Jev call was made. The answers, probabilities and confidences are invented to exercise the code paths. Each request carries only the ticket's words that are in the fixed vocabulary JEV_WORDS, not the ticket text. The live Jev path is not run.

kind.instructions: Which kind of support request do the words in `ticket.words` describe? They are the ticket's words that are in a fixed support vocabulary, in order. Every other word was removed.

webhook_stopped.what: The customer says a Helius webhook stopped delivering events or missed events.
webhook_stopped.not_for: Billing, plan, API key or code questions that only mention webhooks.

other.not_for: A webhook that stopped delivering or missed events.
